alexcrichton opened PR #15093 from alexcrichton:fail-queue to bytecodealliance:main:

This commit fixes a minor issue where creating a component instance could report failure yet actually still queue up work within the event loop to perform instantiation. The fix is similar to #14825 to ensure that work is never queued in the first place before failure is seen.
